The crystal statue is described laying on its side unbroken near the [[Twisted redstone doorframe|redstone doorframe]] in Rhuidean during the fight of [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Asmodean]]. It was laying among all other ''[[ter'angreal]]''.{{Ref/book|4|58}}

==Appearance==
The ''ter'angreal'' is depicted as a fallen crystal statue of a nude woman clasping a child to her breast. Its size is unknown but it is described as Rand and Asmodean rolling on the ground during the fight, they were banging against the redstone doorframe then against this fallen statue, so it must be big enough for that.

==Use==
Its use is unknown.
